message.reasoning:
We need to extract explicit facts.

Text: "IPhone 6

The iPhone 6 and iPhone 6 Plus are smartphones designed and marketed by Apple Inc. The devices are part of the iPhone series and were announced on September 9, 2014, and released on September 19, 2014. The iPhone 6 and iPhone 6 Plus jointly serve as successors to the iPhone 5S and were themselves replaced as flagship devices of the iPhone series by the iPhone 6S and iPhone 6S Plus on September 9, 2015."

We need triplets.

Entities: iPhone 6, iPhone 6 Plus, Apple Inc., iPhone series, iPhone 5S, iPhone 6S, iPhone 6S Plus.

Relations:

- iPhone 6 is a smartphone. relation: "instance of" maybe "type". Use "instance of" or "subclass of"? In examples they used "occupation" etc. For devices, maybe "instance of" with object "smartphone". We'll use relation "instance of". object_type "smartphone". subject_type "device".

- iPhone 6 Plus also instance of smartphone.

- iPhone 6 designed by Apple Inc. relation "designed by". object_type "organisation". Also "marketed by". Could combine? Two separate triplets.

- iPhone 6 Plus designed by Apple Inc.; marketed by Apple Inc.

- iPhone 6 part of iPhone series. relation "part of". object_type "product series". same for iPhone 6 Plus.

- iPhone 6 announced on September 9, 2014. relation "announcement date". Could be "point in time" qualifier on "announced". Use relation "announced". object maybe "iPhone 6". But we need subject is iPhone 6, relation "announced". object maybe "announcement". In examples they used "award received" with qualifier point in time. Here we can have relation "announced" with object "iPhone 6". But that seems odd. Better: relation "announcement date" with object date. Use "point in time" qualifier? Actually date is object. So relation "date of announcement". We'll use "date of announcement". object date.

Similarly for iPhone 6 Plus same dates.

- iPhone 6 released on September 19, 2014. relation "date of release".

- iPhone 6 Plus date of release same.

- iPhone 6 successor to iPhone 5S. relation "successor". object iPhone 5S. Also iPhone 6 Plus successor to iPhone 5S (jointly serve as successors). Could have two triplets.

- iPhone 6 replaced as flagship device by iPhone 6S on September 9, 2015. relation "replaced by". object iPhone 6S. qualifier point in time.

- iPhone 6 Plus replaced by iPhone 6S Plus on same date.

- iPhone 6 and iPhone 6 Plus are flagship devices of iPhone series before being replaced. Could have relation "position in series" but not explicit. We'll stick to above.

Now need subject_type and object_type.

Define types:

- iPhone 6: device (smartphone). object_type for smartphone: "smartphone". For Apple Inc.: "organisation". For iPhone series: "product series". For date: "date". For iPhone 5S: "device". For iPhone 6S: "device". For iPhone 6S Plus: "device". For relation "designed by": object_type "organisation". "marketed by": same.

- For "successor": object_type "device". For "replaced by": object_type "device".

Now qualifiers: For announcement and release dates, we can embed date as object, no qualifier needed. But we could also have qualifier "point in time". In example they used "award received" with qualifier point in time. Here we have date as object, simpler.

But there are two dates per device: announced and released. So separate triplets.

Now produce JSON.

List of triplets:

1. iPhone 6 instance of smartphone.
2. iPhone 6 Plus instance of smartphone.
3. iPhone 6 designed by Apple Inc.
4. iPhone 6 marketed by Apple Inc.
5. iPhone 6 Plus designed by Apple Inc.
6. iPhone 6 Plus marketed by Apple Inc.
7. iPhone 6 part of iPhone series.
8. iPhone 6 Plus part of iPhone series.
9. iPhone 6 date of announcement 9 September 2014.
10. iPhone 6 Plus date of announcement 9 September 2014.
11. iPhone 6 date of release 19 September 2014.
12. iPhone 6 Plus date of release 19 September 2014.
13. iPhone 6 successor of iPhone 5S. (or "successor" relation)
14. iPhone 6 Plus successor of iPhone 5S.
15. iPhone 6 replaced by iPhone 6S with qualifier point in time 9 September 2015.
16. iPhone 6 Plus replaced by iPhone 6S Plus with qualifier point in time 9 September 2015.

Check pronoun resolution: "were themselves replaced as flagship devices of the iPhone series by the iPhone 6S and iPhone 6S Plus on September 9, 2015." So replaced by those devices. Good.

Now format qualifiers list: for triplets 15 and 16 include qualifier {"relation":"point in time","object":"9 September 2015"}.

All other qualifiers empty.

Now produce JSON.
